card.name: Numbers in hours and pound-kg conversions
card.fires_on: The second digit of a two-digit hour interval such as 12 or 24 hours in dosing tables, and the opening parenthesis or first digit of a kilogram value right after a weight in pounds.

modes.label: Hour intervals
modes.description: The last digit of numbers like 12 or 24 just before the word hours in dosing-frequency tables.

modes.label: Pounds then kilograms
modes.description: The parenthesis or first digit that begins the kg equivalent right after a weight in lb.

card.writes: It pushes toward odd, unrelated tokens and suppresses number words like three, six and seven, so there is no clear output effect on the next number.
card.plain: It lights up on the hour number in a dosing schedule and on the kilogram figure that follows a weight in pounds.
